MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 28
   C. 22
   D. 33

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

3. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

12. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
